en-US.subtitle: Calm ADHD to-dos & planner
en-US.description:
Most to-do apps push you — streaks, scoreboards, red "overdue" badges. Sagely steadies you. Meet Mochi, a warm little companion who helps you get what's on your mind out of your head, break the scary stuff into small steps, and gently keep today in view.

Nothing here is ever "late" — just "carried over," and always reversible. There are no streaks, no scores, no "X days in a row." If today was a lot, today was a lot. Sagely doesn't grade you on it. Built for ADHD and easily-overwhelmed minds; loved by anyone tired of feeling behind.

THE BASICS, DONE GENTLY

• To-dos with priority, due dates, recurrence, categories, and steps (subtasks)
• Recurring tasks: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or custom (specific weekdays, "second Thursday," with optional end date)
• Categories with custom colors and an 80+ icon library — configurable and drag to reorder
• Sign in with Apple, Google, or email
• Cross-device sync via secure cloud storage

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Past-due is "Carried over," not "Late." A soft re-entry, not a failure.

Finished and deleted to-dos rest in Done for 30 days — change your mind and they're still there.

Finishing something gets a small, quiet celebration — no streaks, no scores, no counter that resets when life happens.

Mochi, your steady companion, turns what's on your mind into a to-do. Never pushy. Never hyped. Just there.


TODAY, AND ONLY TODAY

Open Sagely and you land on Today — a quiet view of just today and whatever carried over from yesterday. The whole backlog isn't shouting at you the moment you open the app. Every check-off comes with an Undo.


DESIGNED FOR THE HARD MOMENTS

• Notes per to-do — write what's blocking you, the smallest first step, why it matters. Your thinking stays with the task, not in your head.
• Defer (Tomorrow / In a week / In a month / Pick a date) for the days you can't face an item yet.
• Defer all, for when Carried over feels heavy. Undoable.
• Steps for breaking the scary into the doable. Each step has its own priority and date.
• Deleted to-dos stay in Done for 30 days — nothing is gone by accident.

GENTLE ON YOUR SENSES

• Calm color palette. No anxiety-triggering bright reds — only truly irreversible actions are red.
• Reduce Motion respected throughout: splash animation, completion bounces, row flashes — all skipped when iOS Reduce Motion is on.
• Optional completion sound and animation, both togglable.
• Quiet typography. No exclamation marks anywhere.

PRIVACY-RESPECTING BY DEFAULT

• Your data is yours. Export everything as JSON, anytime.
• Delete your account and everything goes — your data is erased from our servers.
• No third-party analytics tracking behavior across apps. No ads.

AVAILABLE IN

English. (More languages once they're written in the same calm voice.)
en-US.promotionalText: Sagely is the calm to-do app for busy, easily-overwhelmed minds. Mochi, your gentle companion, breaks big things into small steps and never makes you feel behind.
